csv_project_name: PDB for I-680 NB Express Lane Completion
csv_scope_of_work: Progressive Design Build Services for the I-680 Northbound Express Lane Completion. Project may include: Converting the existing HOV lane to an express lane providing access to HOV vehicles and toll-paying drivers. Add an express lane by widening northbound I-680. BRAIDED RAMPS to separate the Treat Blvd off-ramp from the North Main Street/Lawerence way on-ramp to make merging efficient and safer.

title: Progressive Design-Build Services for I-680 Northbound Express Lane Completion
short_description: Design-build for express lane conversion, widening, and braided ramps on I-680 northbound.
project_scope: Completion of the I-680 northbound express lane corridor. The project may include conversion of the existing HOV lane into an express lane for HOV and toll-paying vehicles, addition of an express lane through widening of northbound I-680, and braided ramps separating the Treat Boulevard off-ramp from the North Main Street/Lawrence Way on-ramp to improve merging efficiency and safety.
services: Progressive design-build services; requested disciplines include design-build/developer, civil engineering, public transit planning, traffic design engineering, and transportation planning.
relevance_explanation:
- Road/highway corridor project with potential civil structures, but the notice does not specify any bridge or special structural component.
- Main focus appears to be highway widening, lane conversion, ramps, and traffic/transportation planning rather than structural engineering.
- Procurement is for progressive design-build, which can offer early involvement opportunities.
- No explicit long-span, bridge, roof, stadium, or architecturally demanding structure is described.
- Therefore only limited relevance for sbp.
construction_cost_explanation: Taken from the tender documents: Total Construction Cost $312.0M.
fee_explanation: No explicit planning fee is stated. The notice only provides total construction cost and broad design-build scope; no realistic sbp fee can be derived from the available information.
references_qualifications: Requested disciplines: design-build/developer, civil engineering, public transit planning, traffic design engineering, and transportation planning. No specific reference counts or qualification thresholds are stated in the notice.
